AdminEntry.title: AdminEntry
AdminEntry.description: Authorized administrator identity document keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator matching the document ID.

email.description: Verified email address of the administrator.

grantedBy.description: Email or UID of the administrator who granted this role.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on update.

AppAccessConfig.title: AppAccessConfig
AppAccessConfig.description: Global customer access policy controlled by administrators.

customersAllowed.description: Whether customer accounts are currently allowed to use the booster app.

maintenanceMessage.description: Message shown to customers when global access is paused.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on update.

UserSession.title: UserSession
UserSession.description: Live user login, active screen presence, device telemetry summary, and admin-controlled access flag.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user matching the document ID.

displayName.description: User display name from Google Sign-In.

email.description: User email address from Google Sign-In.

role.description: Authoritative user role enforced by security rules.

accessEnabled.description: Admin-controlled flag enabling or suspending user access to the app.

blockedReason.description: Optional reason provided by admin when accessEnabled is false.

sessionActive.description: True when the user currently has an active app session.

currentScreen.description: Current booster screen or status label.

activePresetName.description: Currently active sensitivity or FPS preset summary.

lastActiveAt.description: Server timestamp of latest heartbeat or navigation.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on update.

/admins/{adminUid}.description: Registry of additional admin accounts granted by an existing admin.

/app_config/{configId}.description: Global application access control policy at /app_config/global.

/user_sessions/{userId}.description: Authenticated user session telemetry, active status, and admin access control.
